marketplace.name: twt-marketplace
marketplace.description: Marketplace hosting the twt web-design pipeline plugin and its standalone units.

bundle.name: twt
bundle.description: Four-phase web-design pipeline: every twt skill in one install.

twt-pre-design.description: Phase 1: spec, brand, positioning, audience, IA, curation, and content fetching.

twt-design.description: Phase 2: visual direction, design system, components, layouts, and HTML mockups.

twt-develop.description: Phase 3: build the design into a static HTML site, an Elementor child theme, or an existing codebase.

twt-qa.description: Phase 4: accessibility, content, design, link, and Elementor audits plus a launch-readiness gate.

twt-site.description: Master orchestrators that run the full pipeline, plus the marketplace meta skills.

twt-export.description: Standalone: Markdown to polished PDF, DOCX, and PPTX/slide exports with themeable house styles.

twt-write-as-me.description: Standalone: build a reproducible writing-fingerprint profile from your samples, then generate against it.

twt-wiki.description: The project wiki: durable memory of decisions, ideas, entities, and cited facts.

twt-seo.description: Per-page keywords, slugs, meta drafts, schema, and a redesign redirect map.

twt-block-map.description: Map a site's block architecture: nested block tree, name-blind identity, and a page-to-block reuse matrix.

twt-fidelity.description: Build a block or page to measured fidelity against a Figma frame, a reference URL, or an image.

twt-design-system-audit.description: Audit a real design's system quality and cross-page block consistency from a Figma file or site URL.

twt-figma-dev-audit.description: Audit a Figma file for developer readiness before implementation starts.

twt-link-check.description: Probe every link and asset on a page, a whole site, or a built folder and report the bad ones.

twt-search-site.description: Search a website for an exact string and report every page link with surrounding context.

twt-figma-read.description: Read a Figma design accurately before implementing it, with measured and estimated values kept honest.
